notes: Tuition: The pages do not state a fee specifically for a self-financed student from outside the EU/EEA for this programme. The Fees page gives a general fee of EUR 4,000 per semester for Bachelor's degree programmes – The University of Buckingham (6 paid semesters), but it is an institution-wide figure and not stated for this programme, so tuition is left out. Application deadline: the page shows '30 September 2026*' under the September 2026 column for Bachelor's programmes, but that is a general deadline not marked for international or non-EU applicants, so it is left out. The page states 'Hungarian citizens for the BSc programmes with the Dublin Business School, De Montfort University, or B.H.M.S. options must apply only on FELVI.HU until 6 August 2026 (PÓTFELVÉTELI) for the September 2026 intake.' — that is for Hungarian citizens only.
